series: VALDA · How it gets to you

scenes.kicker: From our factory to your site
scenes.head: How do our windows get to you?
scenes.say: How do European windows get to your job site? Here's the whole journey.

scenes.head: It starts with your openings
scenes.say: It starts with your openings. Our engineers draw every window, and you approve the drawings.

scenes.head: Built in our own factories
scenes.say: Then we build them in our own factories in Bulgaria, and check every single one.

scenes.head: Packed for the Atlantic
scenes.say: Each window is packed and protected for the Atlantic crossing.

scenes.head: Across the ocean
scenes.say: We ship by sea, with full export documents.

scenes.head: Cleared at the US port
scenes.say: At the US port, we can clear customs for you, or your own broker can.

scenes.head: Straight to your site
scenes.say: Then a truck brings them straight to your site, coast to coast.

scenes.head: Factory to final window
scenes.say: One team, from the first drawing to the final window. VALDA.
